description: Trivial arithmetic — applicability gate item 1 (meaningful input space) fails, which is a hard stop. Grades the REFUSAL path: the skill's first rule is to stop without writing fuzz code, and every other fixture grades what happens after the gate passes.
bad_expected_reasons: emitted a fuzz harness for a target the gate must refuse
notes: Without this fixture the offline eval only ever graded suitable targets, so 'fuzz everything you are shown' scored as well as running the gate. A live A/B needs both arms: a target to accept and a target to refuse.
